versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyRxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyRxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyRxData call: • info The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyRxData shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkCopyRxData call- back.
